summary.zh: 自动创建密钥的平台列表从 33 个精简到 31 个；Cloudflare 和 Google AI Studio 改为手动添加密钥，其余功能不变。
summary.en: The auto-create key list is streamlined from 33 platforms to 31; Cloudflare and Google AI Studio keys are now added manually. Everything else is unchanged.

highlights.zh: 自动创建列表移除了 Cloudflare 和 Google AI Studio 两个入口，保留 31 个一键创建的平台。
highlights.en: Cloudflare and Google AI Studio entries are removed from the auto-create list; 31 one-click platforms remain.

highlights.zh: 这两个平台仍可正常使用：手动添加密钥即可，模型和同步功能不受影响。
highlights.en: Both platforms still work: add their keys manually — models and sync are unaffected.

highlights.zh: 文档与界面中的平台数量说明统一更新为 31。
highlights.en: Docs and UI copy now consistently say 31 platforms.
